------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  Compile an industrial ISCAS-85 cone through the verified route (②)
--  Represent c432 output N370's 132-gate fan-in cone as `Netlist` data,
--  generated by experiments/gen_netlist_data.py. Each gate carries its
--  two-input gadget and `Fin` fan-in indices into the bus below. Passing
--  this value through `Locking.NetlistToCircuit` gives
--  c432nl-locked : CompiledLock 18 ksec kapp (importConeF c432nl),
--  a lock constructed correctly for the actual 132-gate host. The host
--  denotation evidence `cf-ok` uses the generic `import-correct` / `nl-correct`
--  proof instead of a cone-specific `refl`. It therefore checks in seconds
--  without normalization expansion. Other cones scale by emitting data in
--  the same way; c880/c1355/c499 cones up to 319 gates use identical imports.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
